summary_en: SHANON Inc. revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026 to implement its first dividend since listing, a 20 yen per share commemorative dividend marking the company's 10th anniversary on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on January 27, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (First Dividend Since Listing and 10th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending December 2026
translation_en_brief:
SHANON Inc. announced on November 13, 2026, that its board of directors resolved to revise the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The company will pay its first dividend since listing, a commemorative dividend of 20 yen per share to mark the company's 10th anniversary on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on January 27, 2027.

The company was established in August 2000 and listed on the TSE Growth market on January 27, 2017. Since listing, SHANON has maintained a no-dividend policy to prioritize internal reserves necessary for business expansion and strengthening of management foundation. In the current fiscal year 2026, the company improved profitability through disciplined execution of business restructuring measures, including the disposition of unprofitable operations and rationalization of selling, general and administrative expenses, combined with continuous productivity improvements.

To express gratitude to shareholders who have supported the company over the years, the board decided to implement the first dividend in the company's history as a listed entity. The commemorative dividend will be paid at the fiscal year-end as a special dividend with no ordinary dividend component.
